items.text: Abburahamu naatuma ow'okuranga obuko bwa Isaaka
Omu kasumi ako, Abburahamu akaba agurusire muno kandi MUKAMA akaba amuhaire omugisa omu bintu byona.
Abburahamu yagambira omuheereza we ayakiraga ekitiinisa ab'omunju ye boona, ayaroleerraga ebintu bye byona ati: “Ta omukono gwawe hansi y'ekibero kyange,
nkurahiize MUKAMA Ruhanga ow'iguru n'ensi, otaliswererra mutabani wange omukazi omu bahara b'Abanyakanaani aba ndukwikara na bo,
baitu genda omwihanga lyange, omu bantu ab'oruganda rwange, nuho oswererre mutabani wange Isaaka omukazi.”
Omuheereza yamugarukamu ati: “Omukazi kakuba ayanga kwija na nyowe omunsi enu; obu mutabani wawe ndimutwara omunsi ei warugiremu?”
Abburahamu yagarukamu omuheereza ati: “Eki otalikisura, okagarra oku omwana wange.

MUKAMA Ruhanga ow'omwiguru, ayanyihire omunju ya isenyowe n'omunsi ei nazairwemu, ayabalize na nyowe kandi ayandahiire naagamba ati: ‘Ensi enu ndigiha abaijukuru bawe’, oku alitumayo malaika akubanzeeyo, nuho oliiha omukazi ou oliswererra mutabani wange.
Omukazi obu alyanga kwija na iwe, obu ekirahiro nkurahiize, kiriba kitakyakukwata kyonka otaligarra oku omwana wange.”
Aho omuheereza yata omukono gwe hansi y'ekibero ky'Abburahamu mukama we, yamurahira nkooku araahikiriza eki amuragiire.
Nubwo omuheereza yatwaire ikumi ha ngamiya za mukama we, yaimukya yagenda Mesopotamiya, yahika omu rubuga rw'owabu Nahora.
Yahuumuza engamiya aheeru y'orubuga, haihi n'iziba ly'amaizi, orwebagyo muno, omu kasumi aka abakazi bagenderamu kuleeta amaizi.
Omuheereza yasaba naagamba ati: “Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wa mukama wange Abburahamu, nkwesengeriize, ompe omugisa kiro kinu, oyoleke mukama wange Abburahamu nkooku omugonza muno.
Dora nyemeriire ha iziba ly'amaizi, kandi bahara b'abasaija ab'omu rubuga nibaija kuleeta amaizi.

Omwisiki ou ndaasaba nti: ‘Nkwesengeriize, tuura ensoha yawe nyweho amaizi’, akagamba ati: ‘Nywa, kandi engamiya zawe ndaazeesera amaizi’, buli ogu, nuwe okomiire omwiru wawe Isaaka. Eki nikyo ndaamanyiraho nkooku oyolekere mukama wange engonzi zawe ezitahwaho.”
Obu akaba atakamazire kusaba, ahonaaho haija Rebbeka muhara wa Beesweri, mutabani wa Mirika, muka Nahora mugenzi w'Abburahamu, yaija ataire ensoha ye ha ibega.
Akaba ali mwisiki nyamibwa, atakahikwahoga musaija, yasirimuka ha iziba yataha amaizi, yarugayo.
Aho omuheereza w'Abburahamu yairuka kumwitirana, yamusaba naagamba ati: “Nkwesengeriize, mpaho otwizi otw'omu nsoha.”
Omwisiki yatuura ensoha ye, yagikwatira omu mikono, yagamba ati: “Nnywa, mukama wange.”
Obu yamazire kumuha amaizi, yagamba ati: “Engamiya zawe nazo ndaaziha amaizi kuhika obu zirahaga.”
Aho, amaizi agakaba gali omu nsoha yagaseesa omu bwato, ahonaaho yagaruka ha iziba, yayesera engamiya ze zoona kuhika obu zahaagire.
Omusaija yaikara amuroleriire aculiire, ayetegereze, oruhanda rwe MUKAMA obu araaba aruhaire omugisa rundi nangwa.

Engamiya obu zaakuukire, omusaija yakwata empeta ey'ezaabbu erukuhikya obulemeezi bwa kimu kya kabiri kya guraamu, n'ebikomo bibiri ebya ha mikono ebirukuhikya obulemeezi bwa guraamu ikumi eza zaabbu,
yamukaguza ati: “Wewe, ngambira, oli muhara wooha?”
Omwisiki yagarukamu ati: “Nyowe, ndi muhara wa Beesweri, mutabani wa Mirika, ou yazairweho Nahora.”
Yayongera yagamba ati: “Tunyina obunyansi n'ebyokulya bingi, n'omwanya ogw'okuraaramu.”
Omusaija yainama, yaramya MUKAMA,

yagamba ati: “MUKAMA akugizibwe, Ruhanga wa mukama wange Abburahamu, anyakwolekere mukama wange engonzi n'obwesige bwe. MUKAMA anyebembiire omu muhanda, yampikya ha nju ey'ab'oruganda rwa mukama wange.”
Omwisiki yairuka, ebi byona, yabisubirra ab'omuka ya nyina.
Rebbeka akaba anyina munyanya, ibara lye Labbani, Labbani yairuka, yahika ha iziba, omusaija nambere akaba ali.

Obu yarozire empeta n'ebikomo ebinyakuli ha mikono ya munyanya, kandi ahuliire n'ebigambo Rebbeka munyanya ebi yagambire ati: “Omusaija nukwo angambiire ati.” Labbani yagenda yaihayo omusaija, yamusanga ha iziba ayemeriire haihi nengamiya ze.
Yamugamba ati: “Rugayo, otaahe mu ka, iwe MUKAMA ou ahaire omugisa, kiki ekikwemeriize aheeru? Enju ngiteekaniize, n'ekiikaro engamiya ha ziraaraara.”
Aho, omusaija yataaha omunju, Labbani yaiha amatandiko ha ngamiya yaziha obunyansi, yamuha amaizi ag'okunaaba ebigere, n'agandi ag'abasaija aba akaba anyinabo, banaaba ebigere.
Nubwo baamusembereza ebyokulya alye, baitu uwe yagamba ati: “Tindukwija kulya kantu, ntakabalize eki nyiziriire.” Labbani yagamba ati: “Kigambe.”
Aho, omuheereza yagamba ati: “Nyowe, ndi muheereza wa Abburahamu,
MUKAMA akaha mukama wange emigisa nyingi, afookere muntu w'ekitiinisa, amuhaire amagana g'ente, ag'embuzi n'ag'entaama, efeeza n'ezaabbu, abairu n'abazaana, engamiya n'enkaina,
Saara muka mukama wange, akazarra mukama wange omwana omwojo, kandi kunu akaikwire, baitu omwana ogu, Abburahamu amuhaire byona ebi anyinabyo.
Mukama wange akandahiza naagamba ati: ‘Otaliswererra omwana wange omukazi, omu bahara b'Abanyakanaani, bakama b'ensi ei ndumu,
baitu ogende omunju eya ise nyowe, omu ruganda rwange, nuho oswererre omwana wange omukazi.’
Nagarukamu mukama wange nti: ‘Obundi, omukazi asobora kwanga kwija na nyowe.’

Baitu yagamba ati: ‘MUKAMA ou mpeereza alituma malaika we agende na iwe, kandi atereekereze orugendo rwawe, nukwo oswererre mutabani wange omukazi arukuruga omu b'oruganda rwange n'omunju ya ise nyowe.
Obu olihika omu banu ab'oruganda rwange, buli endahiro enu, eriba etakyakukwata; kakuba omukazi batamukuha, nabwo endahiro enu, eriba etakyakukwata.’”
“Kiro kinu obu mpikirege ha iziba nasaba nti: ‘Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wa mukama wange Abburahamu, obu oraaba noosiima kuha omugisa orugendo rwange runu,
hati nyemeriire ha iziba ly'amaizi omwisiki arukwija kuleeta amaizi, ou ndaasaba nti: “Nkwesengeriize, ompe otwizi otw'omu nsoha yawe nnyweho,” araagarukamu ati:
“Nnywa, kandi n'engamiya zawe nazo ka nzesere,” buli ogu nuwe mukazi, MUKAMA ou akomiire omwana wa mukama wange.’
“Obu mbaire ninkyasaba, Rebbeka yaija ataire ensoha ha ibega, yasirimuka ha iziba, yataha amaizi. Namusaba nti: ‘Nkwesengeriize, mpaho amaizi nywe.’
Ahonaaho yatuura ensoha, yagamba ati: ‘Nnywa, engamiya zawe ndazeesera.’ Aho nanywa, n'engamiya nazo zaanywa.
Nubwo namukaguza nti: ‘Iwe oli muhara w'oha?’ Yagarukamu ati: ‘Ndi muhara wa Beesweri mutabani wa Nahora ou yazaireho Mirika.’ Namujweka empeta ha nyindo, n'ebikomo ha mikono.
Aho nainama, naramya kandi nasiima MUKAMA Ruhanga wa mukama wange Abburahamu anyakunyebembiire kurungi nswererre omwana wa mukama wange omu bantu ab'oruganda rwe.
Yagambira Labbani ati: “Obu muraaba muli b'okukorra mukama wange ebirungi, kandi eby'amazima, mungambire, obu kiraaba kitalikyo, nabwo mungambire, ngende handi.”
Aho Labbani na Beesweri baagarukamu bati: “Eki kigambo kya MUKAMA, itwe titwakugambire ekibi rundi ekirungi.
Rebbeka ngugwo, akuli omumaiso, mutwale, mutabani wa mukama wawe amuswere nkooku MUKAMA agambire.”
Omuheereza w'Abburahamu obu yahuliire ebigambo byabo, yagwa hansi yaramya MUKAMA.
Yasumurra ensahu, yaihamu eby'okwekunisa eby'efeeza n'eby'ezaabbu, n'ebyokujwara, yabiha Rebbeka, kandi yaha munyanya omwisiki na nyina ebisembo eby'omuhendo.
Hanyuma uwe n'abasaija abakaba bali na uwe, baalya, baanywa, kandi baaraara aho ekiro eki. Nyenkya obu bwakiire, omuheereza yagamba ati: “Hati, ka ngarukeyo owa mukama wange.”
Munyanya omwisiki na nyina baagarukamu bati: “Leka omwisiki amale naitwe akasumi kake, haakire ebiro ikumi byonka, ebiro ebi obu biraahwaho, agende.”
Baitu omuheereza yabagambira ati: “Muleke kunyikazaaho, habwokuba, eki naiziriire, MUKAMA akimazire, mundeke ngaruke owa mukama wange.”
Baamugarukamu bati: “Ka twete omwisiki, turole eki araacwamu.”
Baayeta Rebbeka, baamukaguza bati: “Nooyenda kugenda n'omusaija ogu hati?” Yabagarukamu ati: “Ego ningenda.”
Nubwo baikiriize Rebbeka munyanya-bo, n'omuheereza we, bagende n'omuheereza w'Abburahamu, hamu n'abantu aba akaba anyinabo.
Baasabira Rebbeka omugisa bati: “Munyanya-itwe, obe nyina abantu obukumi n'obukumi, abaijukuru bawe, basingule abanyanzigwa baabo.”
Aho Rebbeka n'abarukumusendekereza, baatemba engamiya, baahondera omukwenda, omuheereza wa Abburahamu nukwo yatwaire ati Rebbeka, yagenda.
Rebbeka naagabuka omwa Isaaka
Omu kasumi ako, Isaaka, akaba afurukire Beerirahai-roohi agarukire Negebu.
Kiro kimu, omu bwire bw'orwebagyo, Isaaka akagenda omu bwerre, amaiso gamuli omu nkiro, yarora engamiya ziri hara, niziija.
Rebbeka obu yainunukire, yarora Isaaka, yasimburuka bwango hansi,

yakaguza omuheereza w'Abburahamu ati: “Omusaija oli, anyakuli nseeri, arukurubata naatwizira, nooha?” Omuheereza yagarukamu ati: “Ogu, nuwe mukama wange.” Rebbeka yakwata ekitambaara, yakyesweka ha maiso.
Omuheereza yasubirra Isaaka byona ebyabaireho.
Aho Isaaka yataahya Rebbeka mukazi we omu heema, yamuswera, kandi akamugonza muno. Rebbeka yahuumuza Isaaka, yamwebesa obujune obw'okuferwa nyina.
